name: experience-os-workspace
description: Orchestration scripts for the Experience OS monorepo. No application dependencies live here.

scripts.test:rules: firebase emulators:exec --project demo-experience-os --only firestore,storage "npm --prefix firebase/firestore test"
scripts.test:functions: npm --prefix firebase/functions run build && firebase emulators:exec --project demo-experience-os --only firestore,auth,functions "npm --prefix firebase/functions test"
scripts.verify: npm --prefix firebase/functions run typecheck && npm --prefix apps/operations-web run verify
